Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1087
Claimant:
Sean Torres
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2024-05-04
Claim reported by the insured's policyholder after a low-speed head-on collision in a parking area. The claimant
reports neck pain and has retained counsel, who has asked that all contact go through their office.
2024-05-17
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at the time of loss. No issues with the
policy terms have been found.
2024-06-03
Reviewed photos from the scene and the other driver's statement. Both describe the same sequence of events and
the point of contact between the two vehicles.
2024-06-10
Witness statements were obtained and match the account given by both drivers. Nothing in the file contradicts how
the collision occurred.
2024-06-20
Vehicle inspection completed. The damage pattern is consistent with the impact described and the estimated repair is
in line with a collision of this speed.
2024-06-30
Checked prior claims and vehicle history. No earlier damage to this vehicle has been found in any records reviewed,
and nothing suggests the damage predates the policy start.
2024-07-03
Claimant's account was taken again through counsel. The description of the collision and the symptoms that followed
matches what was given in the first report.
2024-07-10
Medical records received. The reported injury, a soft tissue strain to the neck, is a typical result of a collision with this
force. No prior treatment to the neck or upper back appears in the records.
2024-11-08
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is usual for this type of injury. The treating provider's notes give
reasons for the extended course, and we are requesting further detail.
2024-11-26
Clarification requested from counsel on where the claimant was seated at impact, as the statements so far do not fully
settle this. The answer may affect how the injury is assessed.
2024-12-04
Claim remains open pending the seating position response and the final treatment report. No reason to dispute the
core facts of the loss at this stage.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
